title: Wan 2.1 VACE masked edit with reference
description: Masked local video edit that also takes a reference image for the replacement subject. The server normalizes source and mask into an aligned 16 FPS VACE envelope; the reference conditions a full-frame render and only the approved mask area is composited back. Reference colour and silhouette fidelity are approximate.

evidence: Reference fix 0.2.0 (2026-10-26): with reference conditioning the graph passed an edit mask to WanVaceToVideo and the run left the clip untouched except the reference frame and one blend frame (app run 45125fd0, replayed as 37 decoded frames with frame 1 of 37 being the reference picture). The graph now drops that frame with ImageFromBatch, takes the source frame count and lets the final composite restrict the change to the approved mask. The same cleared clip and seed replay gives 480x832 / 33 frames with every frame edited and following the pose. Reference colour and silhouette fidelity stay approximate: the purple velvet jacket reads as a dark red velvet dress that keeps the dress silhouette.
